dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Beans N Toast is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Beans N Toast redirected onto a staff member while exiting the kennel room, delivering a quick bite-and-release to the thigh without an identifiable trigger. Following the incident, Beans N Toast was able to continue the walk and return to kennel without further issue and overall in the care center has been social with staff. Medically, Beans N Toast has CIRDC.

Beans N Toast's came into the care center as a stray; due to this, his behavior history in a home environment is unknown. Beans N Toast's has shown social behavior with handler leaning into touch. Beans N Toast redirected onto a staff member while exiting the kennel room, delivering a quick bite-and-release to the thigh without an identifiable trigger. Due to these concerns, we recommend that Beans N Toast's be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope partner that can address his challenges with the use of a professional trainer/behaviorist who uses positive reinforcement methods only.
